sources.title: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
sources.snippet: It is a single AI model that predicts a tropical cyclone's track, intensity, and wind structure with state-of-the-art accuracy. It achieves this breakthrough through a unique combination of its training, architecture and approach to low resolution inputs.

sources.title: Google DeepMind Open Sources WeatherNext AI Cyclone Forecasting Model
